Game Overview

At its heart, Snail Clicker is a clicker game about click your way to snail supremacy. Multiply snail coins and climb the ranks by unlocking exciting upgrades and skins. With every click, enhance your snail empire in this addictive and charming clicking adventure.

How to Play

Getting started in Snail Clicker doesn't take long to learn. Click your way to snail supremacy! Multiply snail coins and climb the ranks by unlocking exciting upgrades and skins. With every click, enhance your snail empire in this addictive and charming clicking adventure.

Snail Clicker is a free clicker game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

The goal is to click your way to snail supremacy. Multiply snail coins and climb the ranks by unlocking exciting upgrades and skins.
